distinctions.limitation: These definitions do not establish the exact UDiFF close mapping, applicable exception universe, or common trade-state contribution rule for the retained observations.

distinctions.claim: Two nonzero-volume futures rows on 2026-09-10 have close above high; integrity, identities, expiry agreement and exact price preservation pass.
distinctions.limitation: Integrity proves binding to retained bytes, not economic correctness or validity of an exception.
